content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80020 The IocSend / IocWrite function shall not return until the data given in parameter have been completely physically sent over the communication medium. For example in case of communication over shared RAM, an IocSend / IocWrite shall return when all data have been copied in the target shared RAM.
